_comment: TNT Library note_block override. The "" variant is the universal fallback: it specifies zero properties, so it matches EVERY note_block state and keeps them all rendering as vanilla minecraft:block/note_block. Each additional key lists specific properties; because a more-specific variant (more properties matched) wins over a less-specific one, only the exact claimed state is re-skinned while all other states stay vanilla. This is the same partial-key + override technique Oraxen/Nexo use to preserve vanilla note blocks. Active bombs: waterbomb note=19, twins_white note=20, twins_black note=18, smartbomb note=21. Reserved for later phases (fbomb 22, gbomb 23, whiteout 24) are left out until those bombs ship; adding them will not affect vanilla states.
